# Spacer

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

An invisible element that reserves vertical space. Use this to add gaps between content without relying on margins.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Spacer(float height)
new Spacer()
```
